## Publish gate report

**Going out:** landing hero copy, Pebblebrook Tea Co. website, UK audience.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Loose leaf tea, packed by hand in Bristol" | OK. Matches "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" (Operations). Loose leaf is a product fact. |
| "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | OK, but it repeats the first sentence. |
| "certified organic by the Soil Association" | OK. Certificate on file, renewed 2026. |
| "Free UK delivery on all orders" | **Fails.** The policy only supports "Free UK delivery on orders over £25". "All orders" drops the condition, which is also a regulated "free with conditions" offer. |

**Regulated claims:** the only exposure is the free-delivery wording above. There are no health, environmental, urgency or guarantee claims.

**House style:** the voice is warm and plain, and there are no banned words or AI tells. The one weakness is the repeated "packed by hand in Bristol".

**Disclosure:** none needed. This is our own page, with no partnership, affiliate link or AI-labelling trigger.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite):**
- Corrected the delivery claim to the policy wording.
- Removed the duplicated packing line.

> Loose leaf tea, every tin packed by hand in Bristol. Our tea is certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

**Needs a decision:** none on content, beyond accepting the rewrite.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). I can't record approval, and the original draft isn't approved. Sam needs to say yes to the rewritten text above. Then run `approve.py --by "Sam" --what "landing hero copy"` and retry the publish.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "Free UK delivery on all orders.", "type": "other"}], "publish": false}
```
